item.title: Oregon leaders react to ousting of DHS Secretary Kristi Noem by Trump
item.description: President Trump announced that Senator Markwayne Mullin will replace Kristi Noem as Secretary of Homeland Security, effective March 31, 2026, while Noem will serve as the Special Envoy for The Shield of the Americas.
